jobs.title: Enterprise Data Analytics Program Manager - Remote - Nationwide
jobs.description:
Remote, Nationwide – Seeking Enterprise Data Analytics Program Manager
  
  
Everybody Has A Role To Play In Transforming Healthcare
  
  
At Vituity you are part of a larger team that is driven by our purpose to improve lives. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare through our culture by working together to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges from the inside.
  
  
Join the Vituity Team. At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.
  
  
**Vituity Locations:** Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Balance the needs of customers, business teams, and stakeholders with the capabilities and limitations of technical resources throughout the development process, ensuring that what is delivered meets the original goals and objectives of the request or product.
* Operate in areas of uncertainty and ambiguity and provide solid recommendations.
* Facilitate meaningful discussion to help develop sound business requirements and user stories, helping to interpret user needs and experience to design a workflow and/or product that efficiently meets the needs of the customer.
* Collaborate with technical teams and groom backlog to ensure that work efforts are aligned with product and business goals and objectives; assist in resolving roadblocks and managing escalations as required.
* Manage internal documentation (using Confluence) as well as issue/bug/enhancement ticket tracking (in Jira and ServiceNow); create and manage training and supporting content for users and customers (via SharePoint and other platforms).
* Evangelize products by working with key stakeholders to demonstrate value of tools; support user community and identify advocates to partner with.
* Become a subject matter expert in upstream data sources and flow to help identify gaps for various programs and practice lines.
* Participate in planning activities around system upgrades and migrations that would impact data sources or platforms that Practice Management (PM) and Physician Partner (PP) Operations users use directly or indirectly.
* Work with appropriate teams to help troubleshoot mitigate system failures and lapses in service and provide updates to users.
* Responsible for building and maintaining the relationship with the business stakeholders of the assigned platforms and stakeholders of the assigned MVPs.
* Responsible for developing and maintaining effective working relationships with other ITS teams.
* Effectively influences and collaborates with others, presenting and securing approval from senior management and other key stakeholders, as necessary.
* Manage process of data acquisition with RCM Data Acquisition, outside RCM groups, and other EMR vendors and hospital partners.
* Assess areas of opportunity where available data sources and/or systems can be leveraged in a report, dashboard, or tool that can add business value or operational insights.
* Use Tableau and other platforms to develop prototypes and engage with prospective users for feedback; assess value with stakeholders; if/when appropriate, determine next steps and produce documentation for production development.
* Research and stay informed of industry best practices for analytics and business intelligence.
* Provide or facilitate ad hoc analysis and reporting for business requests and needs with complexity or requirements beyond what is readily available within the PMD and other tools.
* Complete formal or informal training on current technology and Data/IT methodologies.
* Quarterly skip meeting with the manager of your manager.
* Identify a mentor and meet on a monthly basis.

Required Experience and Competencies
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution required.
* 3- 5 years of Product Management or equivalent experience required.
* Demonstrated background in using or implementing data analytic tools or dashboards required.
* Background in Hospital, Medical or Pharmaceuticals preferred.
* Knowledge of Cloud Technologies preferred.
* Basic knowledge of SQL or programming language preferred.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office software applications required.
* Working knowledge of the Agile Software Development Methodology preferred.
* Project Management or Program Management Professional (PMP or PgMP) preferred.

The Community
  
Even when you are working remotely, you are an important part of the Vituity Community. We offer plenty of opportunities to engage with other Vitans through a variety of virtual meet-and-greets, events and seminars.
  
  

* Monthly wellness events and programs such as yoga, HIIT classes, and more
* Trainings to help support and advance your professional growth
* Team building activities such as virtual scavenger hunts and holiday celebrations
* Flexible work hours
* Opportunities to attend Vituity community events including LGBTQ+ History, Día de los Muertos Celebration, Money Management/Money Relationship, and more

Benefits Beyond\*
  
Vituity cares about the whole you. With our comprehensive compensation and benefits package, we are mindful of what matters most, and support your needs of today and your plans for the future.
  
  

* Superior health plan options
* Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA, Life and ADD coverage, and more
* Top Tier 401(k) retirement savings plans that offers a $1.20 match for every dollar up to 6% plus discretionar

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Project Manager II
jobs.description:
**About CirrusMD:**

CirrusMD is redefining virtual care by delivering a Physician-first Care & Guidance solution that meets patients at their moment of need. Our text-based (or web) app connects patients with licensed physicians in under a minute, allowing them to engage in care at their own pace and convenience. Available 24/7/365, CirrusMD’s integrated care spans multiple specialties—from acute and chronic care to behavioral health. Our platform serves 10 million users across all 50 states and is offered exclusively through employers and health plans. Learn more at **cirrusmd.com****.**

**Client Onboarding Project Manager**
=====================================

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
-------------------

A great client experience starts long before go-live.

As a Client Onboarding Project Manager at CirrusMD, you’ll be at the center of bringing new clients to life, guiding them from signed contract through implementation, onboarding, and a successful launch.

You’ll connect the dots between clients, consultants, vendor partners, and teams across our organization, turning complex implementations into clear, actionable plans. Some days you’ll be mapping milestones and coordinating workstreams. Other days you’ll be solving an unexpected challenge, bringing the right experts together, or helping a client navigate an important decision.

Through it all, you’ll keep everyone moving toward the same goal: a smooth launch and a client experience that starts strong from day one.

If you love bringing order to complexity, building trusted relationships, solving problems, and watching a big project come together, we’d love to meet you.

**WHAT YOU’LL MAKE HAPPEN**
---------------------------

* Own the launch. Lead new client implementations from signed contract through onboarding and successful go-live.
* Build the roadmap. Create thoughtful, individualized project plans with clear milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and deadlines.
* Connect the dots. Bring clients, consultants, vendor partners, and internal teams together around a shared implementation plan.
* Keep things moving. Track deliverables, communicate progress, manage deadlines, and make sure important details don’t fall through the cracks.
* Partner with technology and data teams. Work closely with Business Intelligence, Information Technology, and other technical resources to ensure each client’s programs are built, supported, and measured effectively.
* Build trusted partnerships. Develop strong relationships with clients, consultants, vendors, and subject matter experts throughout the onboarding experience.
* Solve the messy stuff. Spot potential risks early, remove roadblocks, and escalate challenges when additional support is needed.
* Create a great first impression. Help make every implementation feel organized, responsive, collaborative, and client-focused.
* Jump into other high-impact work. Support priority projects through the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) as opportunities arise.
* Take on other responsibilities as needed to support our clients, team, and business.

**YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF...**
----------------------------------

You’re the kind of person who can keep a complex project organized without losing sight of the people behind it.

You bring:

* A bachelor’s degree.
* Experience in project management and account or client management.
* Experience managing multiple complex projects with competing priorities, stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines.
* A collaborative approach and a knack for getting different teams moving toward the same goal.
* Strong organizational skills and the flexibility to adjust when priorities or plans change.
* Confidence leading meetings, asking thoughtful questions, and helping teams move toward decisions.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including comfort working with clients, leaders, consultants, and subject matter experts.
* The ability to take something complicated and make it easier for others to understand.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Zoom, and similar business tools.
* Professionalism, accountability, and sound judgment when working with confidential information.

Even better: You’ve led implementations within healthcare, health benefits, insurance, digital health, or another complex client environment.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU**
------------------------

Great work is easier when you feel supported at work and outside of it, too. As part of the broader Quantum Health organization, CirrusMD associates have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, growth, and life outside of work.

Compensation: Competitive base pay, incentive plans, and employee referral bonuses.

Coverage: Health, vision, and dental coverage featuring our best-in-class healthcare navigation services, along with life insurance, legal and identity protection, adoption assistance, EAP resources, TelaDoc services, and more.

Retirement: 401(k) with up to a 4% employer match and full vesting from day one.

Balance: Paid Time Off (PTO), seven paid holidays, parental leave, volunteer days, paid sabbaticals, and more.

Development: Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 annually, certification and continuing education reimbursement, discounted higher education partnerships, paid training, and leadership development opportunities.

Culture: A people-first environment built around collaboration, inclusion, community, philanthropy, sustainability, and making a meaningful difference through the work we do.

Environment: A modern workplace experience with casual dress, full-service dining, free snacks and drinks, a complimentary 24/7 fitness center with group classes, outdoor walking paths, a game room, and additional on-site conveniences.

Want a closer look at our workplace? Check out our home.

**READY TO JOIN US?**
---------------------

This role is responsible for translating organizational strategy and priorities into actionable execution plans, ensuring initiatives are delivered on time, with the right stakeholders engaged, and in alignment with broader business objectives. At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

Vanta is looking for a Program Manager to build and scale digital-first customer experiences that accelerate onboarding, product activation, and ongoing adoption. You’ll turn customer insights, product usage data, automation, and AI into programs that help early-stage and mid-market customers realize value and support retention and growth.

### **The team**

The Digital Success Programs team creates scalable, personalized customer experiences that extend the reach of Customer Success. The team partners across Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Education, Community, Data, and Operations to deliver measurable customer outcomes through digital engagement, education, automation, and community programs.

### **The role**

As a Program Manager on the Digital Success Programs team, you’ll own programs across the customer lifecycle and help translate product priorities and customer needs into repeatable, measurable engagement. It is a builder role for someone who can combine program management, customer empathy, data fluency, with strong cross-functional execution.

### **What you’ll do as a Program Manager at Vanta**

* Own one or more digital customer success programs end to end, such as cohort onboarding and one-to-many activation programs that integrate education and community engagement.
* Design, build, and optimize scalable email communications across onboarding, activation, and adoption stages, using customer attributes, product usage signals, and behavioral triggers.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Education, Marketing, and Community to tailor programs to customer segments, adoption milestones, and risk signals.
* Measure program performance against onboarding, activation, engagement, and time-to-value goals, and continuously improve program outcomes.
* Partner on activation strategy and own digital program execution for product launches and strategic adoption initiatives.
* Build activation experiences across email, in-app messaging, educational resources, community programming, and live learning.
* Identify opportunities for proactive intervention and deeper adoption using customer and product data.
* Define program-level success metrics and partner with Data on reporting that connects digital engagement to activation, adoption, and retention.
* Use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to streamline workflows, develop content, analyze insights, and improve program efficiency.
* Build frontline awareness, buy-in, and enablement so partners can successfully adopt and support new programs.

### **How to be successful in this role**

* 5+ years of experience in customer-facing, lifecycle marketing, customer success, or program management roles, preferably in SaaS.
* Experience designing, launching, and optimizing scalable onboarding, product activation, and customer engagement programs, ideally within a digital-first or scaled Customer Success model.
* Strong understanding of the customer journey, product adoption, and retention levers, with experience using behavioral triggers and customer data to deliver targeted, personalized engagements.
* Ability to analyze product usage and engagement data, measure program effectiveness, and continuously optimize for impact.
* Strong project management skills, with a structured approach to defining goals, scope, milestones, and success metrics while independently driving cross-functional initiatives.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and customer-facing content development skills.
* Proficiency with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to improve workflows, accelerate execution, and drive operational efficiency.
* Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake, Customer.io, customer success platforms, or similar systems.
* Exposure to customer education, community engagement, or content strategy.
* Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

jobs.title: Project Manager - AMS - REMOTE
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the steady-state delivery of Application Management Services (AMS) across a diverse Business Services Applications Portfolio. The role will be accountable for day-to-day service delivery, operational stability, SLA and KPI performance, stakeholder management, resource planning, financial performance, service governance, and continuous improvement across ERP, non-ERP, SaaS, packaged, custom, and legacy applications.
  
  
The Project Manager will serve as the primary delivery leader for the Business Services portfolio and will work closely with business stakeholders, application owners, IT leadership, delivery teams, and third-party vendors to ensure reliable operations and measurable service improvement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Service Delivery Operational Management
  
  

* Own day-to-day delivery of application support services across the Business Services portfolio.
* Balance service priorities across applications with different business criticality, support models, technology maturity, ticket volumes, and lifecycle stages.
* Ensure achievement of agreed SLAs, KPIs, service quality targets, and contractual commitments.
* Manage Incident, Problem, Change, Request Fulfillment, and Release Management processes across the portfolio.
* Monitor production stability, critical incidents, recurring issues, aged backlog, and service risks.
* Coordinate resolution of issues spanning application, infrastructure, database, integration, security, and third-party vendor teams.
* Ensure appropriate operational coverage, escalation paths, and support readiness across the portfolio.

Application Portfolio Management
  
  

* Maintain visibility into application ownership, support models, dependencies, criticality, risks, and resource coverage.
* Prioritize operational focus based on business impact, service performance, risk, and support demand.
* Identify key-person dependencies, skill gaps, aging technologies, and application lifecycle risks.
* Ensure appropriate support strategies for SaaS, COTS, custom, legacy, ERP, and non-ERP applications.
* Coordinate activities across application teams where incidents, changes, integrations, or business processes span multiple systems.

Service Governance Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Act as the primary customer-facing delivery leader for the Business Services portfolio.
* Build trusted relationships with business stakeholders, application owners, product owners, IT leadership, service management teams, and third-party vendors.
* Conduct regular operational reviews, service reviews, governance meetings, and executive-level reporting.
* Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of critical production and service delivery issues.
* Communicate service performance, risks, dependencies, improvement initiatives, and key decisions clearly to stakeholders.
* Drive customer satisfaction and maintain alignment between service delivery priorities and business needs.

Resource Workforce Management
  
  

* Manage globally distributed application support teams across multiple technologies and business domains.
* Ensure appropriate resource capacity and skills across applications with varying demand, complexity, and business criticality.
* Manage workforce performance, utilization, productivity, retention, and development.
* Drive cross-training, succession planning, and knowledge retention to reduce dependency on individual resources.
* Support recruitment and onboarding for identified skill or capacity gaps.
* Build a cohesive delivery organization across internal teams, client teams, and vendor resources.

Financial Management
  
  

* Manage operational budgets, forecasts, and financial performance for the engagement.
* Align resource capacity and staffing with contractual commitments and forecast demand.
* Monitor utilization, productivity, and other relevant financial and delivery metrics.
* Identify opportunities for resource optimization, productivity improvement, and cost efficiencies.
* Ensure delivery remains aligned with contractual and financial objectives.

Continuous Improvement Transformation
  
  

* Develop and execute a Continuous Service Improvement roadmap for the Business Services portfolio.
* Use service data, ticket trends, recurring incidents, problem records, and application health indicators to identify improvement opportunities.
* Drive reduction in recurring incidents, aged backlog, manual effort, and avoidable ticket volumes.
* Identify opportunities for automation using ITSM platforms, application-native capabilities, workflow automation, monitoring, AI, knowledge management, and other appropriate technologies.
* Promote proactive problem management and root cause analysis.
* Drive service maturity, operational excellence, and measurable productivity improvements.
* Track and communicate the business and operational benefits delivered through improvement initiatives.

Governance, Risk Compliance
  
  

* Ensure adherence to ITIL processes, security policies, audit requirements, and applicable compliance standards.
* Maintain appropriate service documentation, SOPs, knowledge repositories, and operational procedures.
* Monitor service risks, contractual obligations, and operational dependencies through structured governance.
* Ensure audit findings, security issues, vulnerabilities, and compliance actions affecting supported applications are appropriately tracked and managed.
* Support internal and external audits as required.

**Basic Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in IT services, application support, or technology delivery.
* 5+ years of experience managing enterprise application support, AMS, or managed services engagements.
* 5+ years experience managing globally distributed teams and multi-vendor delivery environments.

jobs.description:
**Why NorthWinds**

We’re not just building software — we’re building a place where employees can learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.

What we offer:

* Full-time remote work with flexibility and trust
* Competitive base salary and annual bonus program
* Generous PTO, floating holidays, and volunteer time off
* 401(k) with 100% employer match for the first 6% (pre-tax or Roth)
* Comprehensive health benefits and disability coverage
* Profit sharing with discretionary contributions
* HSA, FSA, and dependent care accounts
* A culture built on collaboration, learning, and balance

  

**General Description**

The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, planning, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects according to strict deadlines and budgets. They will ensure consistency with company strategy, commitments and the goals of NorthWinds Technology Solutions.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Define and manage project scope, goals and deliverables that support project objectives working with project sponsor
* Organize and facilitate project planning sessions, daily stand-up meetings, and retrospectives
* Facilitate project status and resource performance discussions with NorthWinds and/or Client managers
* Develop and deliver communication plan with project sponsor
* Communicate project expectations to team members and stakeholders in a timely and clear fashion
* Coordinate project resources with Client and NorthWinds leadership
* Identify and resolve issues and conflicts within the project team
* Identify and manage project dependencies and critical path
* Determine the frequency and content of status reports
* Manage changes in project scope and communicate any budget or schedule changes in a timely manner
* Coach, mentor, motivate and lead project team members and contractors to successfully achieve project objectives
* Conduct retrospective sessions to streamline project throughput
* Facilitate problem resolution and deliverable development between Client Success Managers and NorthWinds teams
* Coordinate project assignments with other team members, such as Product Owners
* Manage special projects as assigned

  

**Non-Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Works very closely with the Client Success Managers to ensure that client needs, and expectations are met

  

**Education/Experience/Personal Requirements**

* Associate degree in business or related field and 3 years of project management experience
* Knowledge of both theoretical and practical aspects of project management
* Knowledge of project management techniques and tools, direct work experience in project management capacity
* The ability to work with all different groups of people within NorthWinds Technology Solutions and Client organizations
* Proven experience in strategic planning
* Proven experience in risk management
* Proven experience in change management
* Proficient in project management software
* Health insurance industry experience helpful
* Ability to operate a computer keyboard, mouse and other office equipment
* Regular, predictable onsite attendance is/may be required at customer sites for sprint reviews, planning sessions, retrospectives etc.; including quarter-driven hours as business demands dictate

  

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
* Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than with the whole hand as in handling.
* Expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Those activities in which they must convey detailed or important spoken instructions to other workers accurately, loudly, or quickly.
* Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound.
* Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time.
* Visual Acuity. The employee is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.

  

**Work Conditions**

The work conditions described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* National travel required <25%

Preferred

* 3 year(s): Experience with strategic planning, risk management, change management, and project management software.

jobs.title: Project Manager, U.S. Advancement - 2025938
jobs.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?

If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.

At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.

If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

  

**ORGANIZATION SUMMARY**

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.

Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

World Relief seeks a Project Manager to become a part of the U.S. Advancement Department. This role serves as the central project and operations lead for the U.S. Advancement team, partnering with marketing, communications, fundraising, church engagement and offices across the U.S. to ensure strategic initiatives are planned, prioritized, and executed effectively. The position manages a portfolio of projects which support 14 U.S. offices and drives organizational alignment, process improvement, resource coordination, and project delivery. Success in this role will be demonstrated through the seamless execution of strategic initiatives across the U.S. Advancement portfolio, ensuring resources are aligned to organizational priorities and workloads are balanced effectively. Key outcomes include a reduction in project bottlenecks, successful delivery of integrated campaigns and initiatives, and stronger partnerships with the 14 U.S. offices, evidenced by enhanced collaboration, increased operational efficiency, and improved satisfaction with the support and services provided by the U.S. Advancement team.

### **ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Project Portfolio Management

* Manage and oversee all U.S. Advancement projects across marketing, communications, donor engagement, church engagement, fundraising campaigns, events, and strategic initiatives.
* Establish project management standards, tools, and best practices.
* Maintain a comprehensive project portfolio and annual roadmap.
* Monitor project scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
* Facilitate prioritization of competing projects and resource allocation for the team.

Strategic Planning & Coordination

* Partner with U.S. Advancement leadership to translate strategic priorities into actionable project plans.
* Lead annual and quarterly planning processes.
* Ensure alignment between national initiatives and the needs of 14 U.S. offices.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, collaboration, and execution.

Operational Excellence

* Create and maintain systems for project tracking, reporting, and performance measurement.
* Document workflows, processes, and standard operating procedures.
* Recommend and implement process improvements.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Management

jobs.title: Customer Success Project Manager
jobs.description:
Amid clinical workforce shortages, rising healthcare costs, and ongoing concerns about inequity, IMPaCT unlocks the power of the grassroots community health workforce.

Here at IMPaCT Care (https://impactcarehq.com/), we get out of bed every day to change lives, with the most effective intervention in the world for addressing health inequity. We find, train and enable Community Health Workers to make magic: caring people who keep their communities healthy. We have built the largest and most scientifically proven Community Health Worker platform in the country, used across 22 states by 70+ organizations like Kaiser Permanente, CVS and United Way. Across multiple randomized controlled trials (https://impactcarehq.com/published-research/), IMPaCT has achieved outcomes frequently believed to be out of reach, including $2,500 in annual savings per patient, improved mental health and a Net Promoter Score of 94. There is even a new Medicare billing code for Community Health Workers that is modeled after IMPaCT!

We are changing the game, but also know the importance of enjoying the journey. We provide competitive compensation and equity grants, comprehensive benefits and plenty of opportunities for team building and fun. Plus you get to work from home.

Curious? Read on.

### **Who You Are**

You are the person who keeps the plan. When 6 people are talking at once on a customer call about data files, go-live dates and who owns what, you are already typing the action items, assigning owners and setting due dates. By the time the call ends, your recap is ready to send.

* **An air traffic controller:** you run a 200-task Asana plan across several customers and always know what is landing next.
* **A live capture pro:** you think while you type, and you organize as you go. Notes land in the right place the first time.
* **One step ahead:** like a great surgical tech who hands over the next instrument before anyone asks, you anticipate what the team and the customer will need next.
* **Unafraid of complexity:** Medicare, Medicaid, SFTP, eligibility files. When you hear a term you do not know, you ask, learn it and use it correctly the next time.
* **Warm and professional:** you welcome customers to a call, deliver hard news with calm and kindness, and guide people through change.
* **Here to master the craft:** you love this kind of work and want to grow in it.

### **What You Will Do**

**Run the plan**

* Build project plans that work backward from customer goals, tracking every deliverable, owner and deadline.
* Capture decisions and next steps in real time in Asana and Salesforce (for example, "Per 6/15 discussion, Sunbelt will pilot new workflows by Q3").
* Act as the hub between internal teams (Product, Tech, Workforce Development, Clinical) and hold everyone to the timeline.

**See around corners**

* Spot risks early and flag them before they become blockers.
* Know what to solve on your own and when to escalate.
* Prepare customers for delays and tradeoffs before they become surprises.

**Deliver for customers**

* Partner with a Director of Clinical Strategy to support 4-12 healthcare customers, depending on complexity.
* Coordinate end-to-end Community Health Worker program launches and platform adoption.
* Prepare agendas, decks and quarterly business reviews, and pull customer reports.
* Own the Tech Review process with customer IT and compliance teams.
* Triage a steady flow of email, Slack and customer requests so nothing is missed.

### **What You Bring**

* **Required: a Bachelor's degree and a project management certification (PMP or CAPM).**
* 2+ years managing complex projects, implementations, or operations with external customers or partners.
* A track record of managing concurrent projects with zero dropped balls.
* The ability to turn a long discussion into a 1-page summary executives love.
* Hands-on skill with Asana or a similar tool, the Google suite, Zoom and a CRM such as Salesforce.
* Ability to work primarily during Eastern Time business hours.
* Occasional travel for team retreats and customer site visits.

**Nice to have:** familiarity with U.S. healthcare (health systems, payers, community-based organizations) or experience at a health tech or SaaS startup.

### **Our Hiring Process**

Live note-taking is central to this role, so we test it early. After you apply and answer a few short questions, selected candidates complete a short live note-taking exercise and a screening interview, followed by a project plan exercise and team interviews.

IMPaCT Care is committed to providing an inclusive interview experience. If you need any accommodations to participate fully, please let us know.

*One of our core values is to create a diverse workplace that welcomes and values each team member's unique perspective, background and ideas. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace.*

### ***About Givzey | Version2.ai***

*Givzey |* *Version2.ai* (http://version2.ai) *is a fully remote, AI-native company that created the Autonomous Fundraising category in 2024, when it researched, developed, and deployed the world's first Autonomous AI to address the labor shortage and capacity gap in nonprofit fundraising. Fundraising teams have a finite capacity to reach donors with one-to-one communication, on average leaving 97% of donors to their organization receiving only marketing communications. A labor shortage compounds the problem: even when organizations want to hire more fundraisers, they often can't find them. The result is a significant capacity gap, where teams can't reach large pools of high-potential donors, resulting in important organizations with world-changing missions being unable to fully execute on their visions.*

*Version2.ai's Virtual Engagement Officers (VEOs) close the labor shortage gap with each VEO independently managing a portfolio of up to 1,000 donors, delivering personalized outreach through text, email, video, and robotically handwritten notes year-round. VEOs don't just make staff more efficient; they manage donor portfolios independently, freeing human fundraisers to focus their time on the highest-value relationships while also closing transformational revenue for these organizations.*

*VEOs have already generated over $20M in fundraising revenue to date, including individual gifts as large as $100,000, at an opt-out rate of just 0.07%. Organizations deploying a VEO see 4x annual ROI on average, and the top 20% see 8x or higher. More than 250 VEOs are now deployed across higher education, healthcare, and nonprofit organizations in the U.S. and Canada, including UNICEF USA, Bucknell University, Wake Forest University, and William & Mary.*

*Adam Martel founded Givzey four years ago and leads the company as CEO. He previously founded, scaled, and sold Gravyty, the first company to develop and sell AI-first solutions to nonprofit organizations.*

**About the role**
------------------

This role sits next to our Product Manager and inside the Engineering team. You'll own the operational side of how we plan, ship, and report on work: the cycle cadence, ticket hygiene, release coordination, and cross-functional program management across product, engineering, ML, and CS.

This is a hands-on, proactive operating role. You're the person a fast-moving engineering team routes through. You keep the work moving without waiting to be asked, and you make the way the team works a little better every cycle.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Cycle operations**

* Run the team's three-week cycle cadence, including kickoff, daily standups, scope check-ins, demos, and retrospectives
* Keep blockers moving by getting each one to the person who can clear it, the same day
* Own the delivery record, the single tracker that shows the team, leadership, and CS where every piece of work stands
* Log lost time against each commitment the day it happens, and flag early when scope needs a cut

### **Ticket hygiene**

* Maintain high-quality tickets with clear acceptance criteria and correct prioritization
* Ensure work is properly structured (parents, dependencies, scope)
* Identify and clean up orphaned, duplicate, or stale tickets
* Push back on stories that are not ready for development

### **Cross-functional program management**

* Coordinate initiatives that span multiple teams, including Product, Engineering, ML, and Customer Success
* Manage dependencies across areas such as integrations, data pipelines, and customer readiness
* Act as the connective tissue to keep projects moving forward
* Route incoming requests to the right place (on-call, a small-fixes queue, or a future cycle) so work doesn't get assigned through DMs

### **Release coordination**

* Track what is included in each release
* Draft release notes and communicate updates clearly to stakeholders
* Partner with Customer Success to prepare for customer-facing changes
* Keep teams informed without creating unnecessary noise

### **Process improvement**

* Identify gaps and inefficiencies in current workflows
* Propose and implement practical improvements
* Continuously evolve team processes rather than simply maintaining them
* Run the team's written playbook from day one, and take ownership of it once you've run a full cycle

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

#### **Experience**

4+ years as a project manager, technical program manager, or scrum master in a software organization.

#### **Working style**

* Comfortable in an engineering room. You can follow a technical debate without needing translation.
* Not afraid to push back when a senior dev says “just trust me.”
* You care about the craft of project management more than the title.
* You have opinions about how teams should work, but aren't dogmatic. Methodology is a tool, not a rulebook.
* You'd rather build a useful spreadsheet than implement a heavy framework.
* Comfortable being the only PM in a room of engineers.
* You're the hub. The team routes through you, so you're reachable and responsive during core hours, and you protect focus time without becoming hard to find.
* You finish what you pick up, completely and correctly, without needing someone to check on it.

#### **Mindset**

* Strong written communication. A lot of our work happens asynchronously and in writing.
* Comfort with ambiguity. We have a written process, and it changes every time we learn something. You'll run it and make it better.
* You care about where the work lands. The dollars our product helps move go to university scholarships, hospital research, and food banks, and that should matter to you.
* Curious about AI as a product surface, not just a hype cycle.
* Excited by building infrastructure from scratch instead of inheriting something polished.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in nonprofit tech, fundraising, or B2B Sa

careers@dvitrainingsystems.com

The Senior Program Manager works at both the high‑level planning layer and the day‑to‑day execution layer to support operational excellence, member experience, and continuous improvement.

This role is essential for aligning timelines, goals, documentation, and operational systems across the Bonneville Labs ecosystem. The Senior Program Manager supports our product mindset by treating each site, service, and workflow as a versioned product that requires continuous improvement, measurable outcomes, and predictable release cycles.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

### **Program Leadership and Oversight**

* Lead assigned programs from ideation through planning, launch, and completion.

* Ensure each project phase has clear ownership, verified completion, and documented quality checks.

* Oversee program dashboards, timelines, and tracking systems using Smartsheets, UpKeep, and related platforms.
* Identify execution gaps and intervene to ensure corrective actions are taken.
* Provide coaching, oversight, and accountability management for the Project Supervisor.
* Translate operational needs into structured backlogs, sprints, and release cycles.
* Maintain consistent standards, workflows, and performance expectations across all sites.

### **Cross‑Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate work across Lab Operations, Lab Safety and Compliance, Facilities, Member Services, Community, Scientific Services, and Business Operations.
* Facilitate communication and reporting to ensure clarity of expectations, deliverables, and timelines.
* Lead cross‑functional project meetings, document decisions, and track action items.
* Support multi‑site initiatives and harmonization of processes across all Bonneville Labs locations.
* Serve as a central point of contact for program updates, escalations, and issue resolution.
* Partner with leadership to ensure programs support member experience, operational uptime, and regulatory compliance.
* Support KPI tracking across programs including uptime, NPS, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency.

### **Documentation and Quality Management**

* Develop, update, and implement SOPs, protocols, and operational documentation.
* Maintain document control procedures including version control, access permissions, and archival.
* Ensure documentation meets regulatory, safety, and quality standards in coordination with the Senior Manager of EHS.
* Convert tribal knowledge into structured, repeatable documentation that supports future site expansion.
* Support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System.
* Assist in development and implementation of Environmental Health and Safety Management Plans and operational guidelines.

### **Continuous Improvement and Product Mindset**

* Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements to workflows, systems, and processes.
* Implement tools and methodologies that enhance tracking, documentation, and reporting.
* Lead harmonization and continuous improvement projects across teams and sites.
* Support development of operational frameworks, testing services, and scalable systems for future sites.
* Recommend improvements that support member experience and operational excellence.
* Support automation initiatives such as ticket routing, asset tracking, and predictive maintenance pilots.
* Contribute to monthly or quarterly operational release notes.
* Coordinate predictable release cycles and communicate improvements across teams and to members.

### **Operations and Site Support**

* Support day‑to‑day operations across multiple Bonneville Labs sites.
* Assist with project planning and ownership of assigned operational systems.
* Provide onsite or virtual support for Bay Area sites as determined by leadership.
* Prepare detailed presentations summarizing program status, risks, and outcomes.
* Support emergency response coordination and communication with external stakeholders when needed.
* Ensure suppliers, contractors, and member companies comply with Bonneville Labs policies and safety guidelines.
* Support operational readiness for new site launches through documentation, playbooks, and process standardization.
* Monitor vendor and contractor performance to ensure service levels support operational uptime and member experience.

### **Stakeholder and Member Support**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, external partners, and member companies.

**About Delinea:**  
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

jobs.description:

We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

About the Role

McKesson is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst to strengthen enterprise security monitoring and incident response capabilities. In this role, you will monitor and investigate security activity, serve as a senior escalation point for complex events, and help determine when an event should be managed as a cybersecurity incident.

You will work with technical and business partners throughout investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery. You will also improve detection logic, response playbooks, and operational processes based on threat intelligence, investigation findings, and lessons learned.

This position is well suited for an experienced security operations professional who combines hands-on technical knowledge with sound judgment, structured problem-solving, and clear stakeholder communication. You will also help develop junior analysts through mentoring and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Do

* Monitor, detect, analyze, and triage security alerts and events across enterprise environments.

* Serve as a senior escalation point for security events and help determine when a cybersecurity incident should be declared.

* Support incident investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reporting.

* Identify common attacker tools, tactics, and procedures using threat intelligence and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

* Improve SIEM and EDR detections, investigation playbooks, alert quality, and incident-response processes.

* Conduct or support proactive threat-hunting and security analysis activities.

* Contribute to post-incident reviews, operational reporting, security metrics, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

* Mentor junior analysts and communicate security risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Basic Requirements

* 6+ years of professional cybersecurity experience, including experience in security operations, threat detection, or incident response.

* Hands-on experience using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) technologies.

* Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and the NIST incident-response lifecycle.

* One or more relevant cybersecurity certifications, such as SANS GCIH, GCIA, CompTIA CySA+, or an equivalent credential.

* Demonstrated ability to investigate security events, analyze incomplete or conflicting data, and develop defensible conclusions.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and prioritization skills.

* Ability to communicate security findings, risks, and recommended actions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Skills/Experience

* Experience with digital forensics, threat hunting, malware analysis, or security automation and orchestration.

* Familiarity with cloud security, cloud-native security monitoring, and identity and access security.

* Experience developing or tuning SIEM correlation rules, EDR detections, alerts, dashboards, or response playbooks.

* Knowledge of cyber threat intelligence and common attacker tools, tactics, techniques, and procedures.

* Experience working in healthcare, pharmaceutical distribution, supply chain, or software environments.

* Familiarity with scripting or automation using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR technologies.

* Ability to rapidly learn, assess, and recommend new cybersecurity tools and technologies.

* Experience mentoring analysts or sharing technical knowledge across a security operations team.

Travel, Work Environment, and Physical Requirements

The work arrangement, location expectations, on-call responsibilities, and travel requirements will be based on the needs of the position and hiring team. The role may require extended computer use and participation in incident-response activities outside standard business hours.

jobs.description:
#### **About Us**

At SimplePractice, we are improving access to quality care by equipping health and wellness clinicians with all the tools they need to thrive in private practice.

More than 250,000 providers trust SimplePractice to build their business through our industry-leading software with powerful tools that simplify every part of practice management. From admin work to clinical care, our suite of innovative solutions work together to reduce administrative burden—empowering solo and small group practitioners to thrive alongside their clients.

Award-winning and people-first, SimplePractice is shaping the future of health tech. In 2026, we were recognized by BuiltIn as a Best Remote Company to Work For, Software Guru's Best Places to Code, Becker Healthcare Telehealth Companies to Know, and we won a MedTech Breakthrough Award for Best Practice Management Solution Provider.

#### **The Role**

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll play a key role in shaping our data-driven culture. Your day-to-day will blend technical problem-solving with strategic thinking—developing metrics frameworks, optimizing reporting pipelines, and uncovering insights that guide Product, Design, Engineering and other key business areas. Using SQL, Tableau, and advanced analytics techniques, you'll transform raw data into actionable insights, empowering stakeholders with the clarity they need. You'll collaborate cross-functionally to define success, measure impact, and drive continuous improvement.  
  
You'll have the opportunity to mentor others and foster a culture of innovation by using data to drive product enhancements and business improvements. Whether designing experiments, optimizing user experiences, or translating insights into action, your work will directly contribute to better business outcomes and customer experiences.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Develop automated reports and dashboards to support product and business operations, ensuring data accessibility and efficiency.
* Analyze complex datasets using SQL and Tableau to uncover trends, drive actionable insights, and influence product roadmaps and executive decisions.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Design teams to deliver data-driven solutions that align with business goals.
* Apply advanced analytics and statistical methods to identify key business trends and optimize decision-making.
* Design and implement scalable data models that integrate multiple sources, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and accessibility.
* Effectively communicate insights and analysis results to stakeholders across SimplePractice, highlighting opportunities to better serve both the business and its customers.
Mentor team members and act as a data subject matter expert, driving best practices in analytics and reporting.  

#### **Desired Skills & Experience**

* 7 years of experience in data analysis and analytics, with a proven track record of mentoring team members.
* Advanced knowledge of data analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL and Python.
* Experience building dashboards and visualizations in Tableau or similar BI tools.
* Ability to interpret complex data using advanced analytics, such as predictive modeling, to forecast trends and optimize business outcomes.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information to multiple stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects and effectively collaborate with multiple stakeholders.
Enthusiastic about data and analytics, learning new techniques and skills, and working with data scientists and engineers.  

#### **Bonus Points**

* Experience with dbt Cloud or similar tools
* Knowledge of ETL pipelines and data warehouse best practices
* Knowledge of techniques such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and multivariate analysis.

* Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
---------------------

FEHE Enterprises, Inc. is seeking a detail-oriented Data Analyst to transform healthcare, financial, and operational information into reliable reports, interactive dashboards, and actionable recommendations. This position will work with leadership and cross-functional teams to monitor performance, identify trends, improve data quality, and support informed business decisions. The role is based in Atlanta, Georgia, with remote work eligibility.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Collect and combine data from claims, enrollment, provider, financial, customer service, and operational systems; maintain organized reporting datasets.
* Clean, validate, reconcile, and investigate incomplete, duplicate, inconsistent, or unusual records; document data-quality checks and findings.
* Analyze claims volume and costs, healthcare utilization, provider performance, service trends, expenses, and operational results to identify drivers and variances.
* Create and maintain Excel and Power BI or Tableau dashboards that track key performance indicators (KPIs), performance against targets, and emerging risks.
* Prepare recurring weekly, monthly, and quarterly management reports, along with ad hoc analysis; summarize findings and recommend practical next steps.
* Identify unusual claims or utilization patterns and prepare exception reports for management review without independently determining misconduct or fraud.
* Support forecasting, budgeting, cost-control initiatives, and process improvements using historical trends and clear analytical models.
* Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Quality Assurance, IT, and other stakeholders to clarify reporting requirements and present findings to nontechnical audiences.
* Protect confidential healthcare and business information, maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails, and follow applicable privacy requirements.

**Qualifications and Technical Skills**
---------------------------------------

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data cleaning, formulas, pivot tables, reconciliation, and analytical reporting.
* Working knowledge of SQL for querying and extracting data; experience creating dashboards in Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience working with multiple datasets, identifying data-quality issues, and translating complex information into meaningful business insights.
* Strong analytical reasoning, accuracy, organizational skills, and the ability to manage deadlines and competing reporting requests.
* Ability to communicate findings clearly in written reports, dashboards, and discussions with leadership.
* Healthcare claims, provider network, utilization, financial, or healthcare operations analytics experience is strongly valued.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Timely and accurate reporting; dependable dashboards; improved data completeness and consistency; clear explanations of trends and exceptions; and actionable recommendations that help leadership monitor costs, quality, and operational performance.

jobs.title: Fraud Intelligence Analyst (New Graduate)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Dashly is a fraud intelligence startup that uses data across employers, insurers, and contractors to fight fraud in injury claims. We expose fraud networks that cost Americans billions of dollars annually, slow commercial development, and erode trust in blue-collar industries.

Backed by Mosaic GP, Altai Ventures, and Remarkable Ventures, with a $5.8M seed round.

**About the Role**
------------------

Fraud is rarely one person acting alone. Organized claim fraud is often run by networks: groups of associated people acting together through a pattern of related claims over time. The cost falls on carriers, contractors, and the industries that depend on fair claims. The evidence is public but fragmented across dockets, deposition transcripts, claim files, and social media.

Dashly investigates organized fraud enterprises: formal or informal groups of individuals, and the counsel, providers, and associates around them, linked by shared addresses, phone numbers, employers, and narratives. We build cases around the structure of organized fraud: the enterprise, each member's association with it, a pattern of related conduct, how long that conduct continues, and its reach across state lines. Our work gives clients and their counsel evidence for fraud litigation.

As a Fraud Intelligence Analyst, you will design, run, and QA the automated OSINT workflows behind our investigations. You will build and orchestrate agentic AI workflows (LLM agents) for account discovery and attribution, court-filing and deposition extraction, media review, and report drafting. You will integrate third-party OSINT, licensed, and public-records data sources via API, and you will own detection quality (precision, recall, and false-positive rate) across the pipeline.

This role suits a recent graduate in cybercrime, cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, computer science, or a related field who combines a builder's mindset with an investigator's rigor. Prior military or government experience is welcome.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design and operationalize automated OSINT workflows that take a claim from initial identifiers to a finished report: account discovery, attribution, collection, court-document extraction, and link analysis.
* Build, prompt, and supervise AI agents and LLM-based automation for investigative tasks, with human-in-the-loop verification before any output reaches a client.
* Integrate OSINT, licensed, and public-records data sources through their APIs, and evaluate each new data source on historical cases before production use.
* Measure and improve detection quality: track precision, recall, and false-positive and false-negative rates against analyst-confirmed accounts, and tune workflows accordingly.
* Identify, attribute, and verify claimants' online accounts and records using strong identifiers (address, phone, email, date of birth).
* Review public photos and posts and flag activity that contradicts claimant testimony or statements to the insurer.
* Extract facts from court filings, deposition transcripts, and claim files, and use link analysis to map relationships among claimants, counsel, addresses, phone numbers, and associates, documenting enterprise structure, member associations, and patterns of related conduct across claims.
* Produce clear, evidence-backed investigative reports that clients and their counsel can use in fraud litigation.
* Partner with senior investigators and engineers to refine investigative methods, tooling, and report quality.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Required:** Experience using AI coding agents, terminal coding agents, or CLI-based AI development tools for research, writing, or code, with the judgment to validate their output (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or open source tools).
* Bachelor's or master's degree (or in progress) in cybercrime, cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, computer science, or a related field.
* 0-2 years of experience in OSINT, investigations, threat intelligence, or a related discipline, including coursework, internships, CTF competitions, or military or government service.
* Working knowledge of OSINT collection and analysis techniques and rigorous source documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience integrating REST APIs and working with structured data (JSON), SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.
* Familiarity with graph and network analysis for detecting linked actor structures.
* Understanding of detection-performance concepts (precision, recall, false positives).
* Familiarity with court records and legal documents, including dockets, deposition transcripts, and fraud complaints.
* Proficiency in Python or a similar scripting language for data analysis and task automation.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Compensation:** The base salary range is $70,000 – $100,000, with flexibility depending on a candidate's background and experience. A company equity plan is also included in our compensation package.
* **Well-being:** 100% medical coverage with dental and vision.
* **Sponsorship:** We welcome candidates on OPT (Optional Practical Training). We do not offer other visa sponsorship.
* **Location:** This role is based on-site 5 days per week in our Chelsea, NY office.
* **Work Expectations:** This role requires a minimum of 50 hours per week.

**Job Description**
-------------------

About the Agency:  
  
  
  
The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) oversees housing standards across all 3.7 million homes in New York City.
  
  
As the nation’s largest municipal housing agency, HPD is responsible for building and preserving affordable housing, protecting tenants from harassment and displacement, and holding landlords accountable across the five boroughs. Under Commissioner Dina Levy and the Mamdani Administration, HPD is pursuing an ambitious housing agenda focused on the needs of New York’s tenants. With a broad set of tools including standards enforcement, tenant resources, and the creation of new affordable housing, HPD is committed to making New York City a more affordable place for renters and homeowners alike.  
  
  
  
Your Team:  
  
  
  
The Office of Development (OOD) leads the agency’s effort to create and preserve affordable housing in collaboration with other HPD offices as well as other city, state and federal agencies. The OOD is comprised of eight divisions that administer a range of programs. These divisions include Portfolio Management & Conversions, New Construction Finance, Special Needs Housing, Building and Land Development Services (BLDS), Homeownership Opportunities and Preservation, Preservation Finance, Compliance and Enforcement, and Housing Incentives.  
  
  
  
The Division of Portfolio Management & Conversions manages development projects after closing with an initial loan to ensure adherence to program and accounting requirements, conversion of construction loans to permanent financing, deployment of rental assistance to tenants prior to project stabilization, and timely completion of these HPD-assisted projects. The division administers multiple programs including Conversions & Rental Assistance, Requisitions, and Construction Monitoring & Completions. These programs facilitate the financial and physical viability, as well as affordability of privately-owned residential buildings throughout New York City. The Division plays a key role in implementation and successful completion housing projects originating from loan programs throughout HPD’s Office of Development.  
  
  
  
Your Impact:  
  
  
  
The Construction & Completions unit is responsible for monitoring the construction of HPD funded affordable housing projects to track and report on construction progress, and to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve significant construction and completion issues that could adversely impact the project, project stakeholders and residents, and/or HPD’s ability to achieve its mission or meet its targets. The unit also assists the Requisions unit to resolve delays and processing issues that could delay the processing of construction requisitions and change orders in a timely manner. In addition, it assists the Conversions program in supporting the timely resolution of issues that might hinder projects’ ability to convert to permanent financing under budget. Finally, the unit actively manages and updates trackers with data regarding all HPD projects between the stages of origination and transition to Asset Management in order to assist leadership in setting targets for completions, in tracking agency progress toward those targets, and in identifying and problem-solving common issues that challenge projects’ ability to complete on time and under budget.
  
  
Your Role:
  
  
As a Project Manager, you will have a portfolio of affordable housing construction and conversion projects you will monitor. For those projects, you will identify construction and completion-related problems that could adversely affect the project’s successful and timely completion by working with: the building engineers, architects and inspectors in BLDS, HPD loan program teams, owners and owner agents; contractors; lenders; and other external and internal partners as required. You will track and report on your findings to the Division and to Office. You will send correspondence and/or communicate with project partners at specific construction milestones to remind partners of current and upcoming obligations. You will also assist with requisitions and construction completion tracking, as well as with tracking and ensuring a subset of projects’ achievement of required milestones for their conversion from construction loans to permanent financing.
  
  
Your Responsibilities:
  
  
The Project Manager will identify construction related problems that could adversely affect project stakeholders, or delay construction and completion, and then creatively problem-solve and resolve those issues within the unique constraints of each project. You will track and report findings to the Division, and lead recurring and ad-hoc meetings with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.  
  
  
  
Other duties include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Report on and track the progress of construction projects versus expected progress, identify projects that are expected to complete on time as well as those that are behind, and identify and document causes for the delays; as needed, manage and update office wide completions Excel tracking spreadsheet, including combining data sources, updating formulas and making project-specific updates

  

* Working with the technical assistance team in BLDS, recommend solutions to owners, the Office of Development, and other stakeholders; facilitate coordination and implementation of resolution

jobs.title: Lead CX Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Gusto**

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

**About the Role:**

Gusto's Customer Experience team is changing how we serve small businesses: new service models, a telephony platform migration, and the data infrastructure to support both. We are hiring a Business Intelligence Analyst to own the data layer that makes this work.

You will work directly with CX leaders to identify and scope priorities, own the foundation of pipelines, data models, and dashboards that make CX data trustworthy, and use that foundation to answer causal questions about what actually moves customer outcomes. The strongest candidates pair real coding and statistical depth with the judgment to know which question is worth answering.

**About the Team:**

CX Data and Insights is the analytical backbone of Gusto's Customer Experience organization. We define the metrics CX leaders run the business on, and we produce the analysis that shapes operational roadmap decisions.

**Here's what you'll do day-to-day:**

* **Lead:** Own ambiguous problems, design analysis and measurement frameworks, and introduce policies and practices by which data integrity is monitored and enforced within your domain.
* **Execution:** Deliver multiple high-impact projects, balancing trade-offs to maximize business value, and maintain clear expectations of deliverables and timelines.
* **Strategic Partnership:** Partner with CX leaders, cross-function data-science teams, tool developers (i.e. Salesforce), and data engineering to align on strategy.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Apply advanced statistical methods and AI-driven anomaly detection to proactively uncover opportunities, diagnose performance issues, and shape CX strategy, separating signal from noise. Navigate messy, conflicting data sources to establish reliable sources of truth. Use AI to accelerate hypothesis generation, code drafting, cross-source reconciliation, validation, and build agents to automate repetitive tasks.
* **Develop and scale reporting:** Define DBT and Snowflake data pipeline requirements for evolving CX data sources, build and maintain monitoring systems, and streamline dashboards for day-to-day operation and self-serve insights.
* **Independence:** Independently determines analytical research, metrics and/or data products to achieve annual objectives, and proactively resolving conflicts or misalignment across stakeholders.
* **Scale the Craft:** Up-level the team's best practices in data modeling and schema design, expand our toolsets (e.g., Databricks for AI-augmented modeling and anomaly detection) where they accelerate CX outcomes, drive improvements in data quality, rigor, and adoption of better data capabilities, and mentor other data practitioners.
* **Communication:** Present complex findings in a structured, compelling way to technical and non-technical stakeholders, fostering a data-informed mindset across the company.

**Here's what we're looking for:**

* 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Data Engineering, or Data Governance.
* Strong SQL and Python proficiency, capable of querying and analyzing large datasets with ease.
* Strong foundation in data modeling, schema design, and data quality best practices, with functional experience working on cloud platforms like Snowflake.
* Proven experience building and maintaining robust data reporting pipelines and ETL workflows.
* Demonstrated experience designing or operating governance for AI-assisted analytics outputs. At minimum: validation standards for AI-generated code and metric definitions, drift and source-of-truth audits on dashboards that feed operational decisions, and documented rules for when human review is non-negotiable on performance-adjacent data products. Comfort working inside an organization's AI use policy.
* Clear, direct communication style. You can explain a complex data investigation to a non-technical stakeholder in 1-2 sentences before diving into the details.
* Comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities, and driving projects forward without waiting for perfect requirements.
* Frequent, practical use of AI in analytics workflows with concrete examples (not aspirational interest). You can describe specific ways AI has changed how you scaffold pipelines, write and review code, validate data, or generate documentation, and you know where human verification is non-negotiable.

Our cash compensation amount for this role is $132,210/yr to $165,263/yr in Denver, $160,000/yr to $200,000/yr for New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither.
